question: India Launches Cancer Care Training Program For BIMSTEC Nations At Tata Memorial Centre. This initiative was announced by Prime Minister Narendra Modi during the ________________.
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**6th BIMSTEC Summit**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• India Launches Cancer Care Training Program For BIMSTEC Nations At Tata Memorial Centre.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
India has launched a **Specialized Training Program in Cancer Care** for **BIMSTEC countries**.

 
 
• 
 
The program is hosted at **Tata Memorial Centre (TMC)** in **Mumbai**.

 
 
• 
 
This initiative was **announced by Prime Minister Narendra Modi** during the **6th BIMSTEC Summit**.

 
 
• 
 
It is being implemented by the **Ministry of External Affairs (MEA)** in collaboration with the **Department of Atomic Energy (DAE)**.

 
 
• 
 
The program aims to **address the rising cancer burden** and reduce **disparities in oncology services** across **South and Southeast Asia**.

 
 
• 
 
**BIMSTEC** stands for **Bay of Bengal Initiative for Multi-Sectoral Technical and Economic Cooperation**.
